title: 第81章 炖肉飘香满村
content_zh:
第81章 炖肉飘香满村-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

存书签

下一章

等到村长走了后，院子内土灶铁锅内，咕嘟咕嘟冒着泡的大块獐子肉混合着老酱油，八角，花椒，干辣椒的味道，在土坯院子内弥漫，飘荡在石溪村的上空。

这一次，一整只獐子全部被卤煮了。

去掉皮后，连着骨头也就还剩下三十来斤，好在这土灶上的锅比较大，满满当当的都是诱人的肉块，一个个切成鸡蛋大小，啃起来满口留香，肉香四溢。

除了獐子肉之外，铁锅里面还放了一部分土豆块，榛蘑，煮熟的鸡蛋，还有一些其他的干货。

可以说，这一锅肉，营养满满。

色香味俱全。

整个石溪村的上空，都飘着乱炖獐子肉的香味，不少村民在家里闻着肉香味，真是抓耳挠心的难受啊！

香啊！

真的是太香了。

不少出来遛弯的村民，也都忍不住朝着李青山家中望去，简直望眼欲穿。

“李青山家里烧什么呢？怎么这么香？”

“还能烧什么，烧的肉呗！”

“娘嘞，这得烧了多少肉啊，味道这么浓郁？”

“下午的时候我路过看了一眼，李青山家里好像杀了一只獐子，估计炖了一只獐子吧？”

“啥，炖了一整只獐子，吃得完吗？这也太败家了？”

“今天木匠，李财，李钢，铁匠，大壮，红旗还有几个人不是在李青山家里干活吗？还有李青山家里几口人，得有十几个人，估计能吃掉一多半吧，剩下一些明天还能接着吃，也不会浪费太多。”

“娘的，早知道刚刚我也去帮忙了，谁知道他们吃的那么好啊。”

“有肉吃，就是让我白干活我也干啊！”

“没用的东西，还好意思说呢，老娘自从跟了你，就没怎么沾过荤腥，你看看人家李青山，天天不是吃肉就是吃肉，你有个什么用啊？”

“媳妇，昨天晚上你不是刚吃过荤腥吗？”汉子脸上流露出一抹猥琐道。

“你个没用的东西，还好意思说，一分钟都坚持不了的废物，要是已经还这么没用，老娘迟早让你跟支书一家一样，我看青山就很不错，哼……！”

一个刚刚嫁过来不久得小媳妇，冷哼一声道。

“哈哈，去年在大河里面洗澡的时候，我就知道你小子不行，没想到还真不行啊……！”

Chapter 81 The aroma of stewed meat fills the village - "Climbing the Mountain 1957: Two pounds of pork in exchange for a wife"

After the village chief left, the smell of bubbling chunks of deer meat mixed with old soy sauce, star anise, Sichuan peppercorns, and dried chili peppers filled the adobe yard and floated over Shixi Village.

This time, a whole deer was braised.

After removing the skin, there were only about thirty kilograms left with the bones. Fortunately, the pot on the earthen stove was relatively large, and it was full of tempting meat pieces. Each one was cut into egg-sized pieces, and when you chew it, it leaves a fragrant aroma in your mouth. The aroma of the meat is overflowing.

In addition to the deer meat, some potato pieces, hazelnut mushrooms, hard-boiled eggs, and some other dry goods were also placed in the iron pot.

It can be said that this pot of meat is full of nutrients.

Full of color and fragrance.

The entire Shixi Village was filled with the aroma of stewed deer meat. Many villagers smelled the aroma of meat at home, which was really heart-breaking and uncomfortable!

It smells good!

It's really delicious.

Many villagers who came out for a walk couldn't help but look at Li Qingshan's home, and they couldn't help but stare.

"What is Li Qingshan cooking at home? Why does it smell so good?"

"What else can we cook? Just meat!"

"Mom, how much meat must be cooked to make it taste so rich?"

"I passed by and took a look in the afternoon. Li Qingshan's house seemed to have killed a deer, and probably stewed one?"

"What, you stewed a whole deer deer, can you finish it? This is too wasteful?"

"Today, carpenter, Li Cai, Li Gang, blacksmith, Da Zhuang, Hong Qi and a few others are working at Li Qingshan's house, aren't they? There are also several members of Li Qingshan's family. There must be more than a dozen people. I estimate that more than half of them can be eaten. The rest can be eaten tomorrow, and it won't be wasted too much."

"Mom, if I had known I had gone to help just now, who would have known they ate so well."

"If you have meat to eat, I will do it even if I have to work for nothing!"

"It's useless, you have the nerve to say it. Since I followed you, I haven't had much contact with meat. Look at Li Qingshan, he eats meat every day. What's the use of you?"

"Daughter-in-law, didn't you just eat meat last night?" the man said with a trace of vulgarity on his face.

"You're a useless thing. You have the nerve to say that you can't last a minute. If you're already so useless, sooner or later I'll make you the same as the party secretary and his family. I think Qingshan is very good, hum...!"

A newly married young daughter-in-law snorted coldly.

"Haha, when I took a bath in the river last year, I knew that you were not good at it, but I didn't expect that you were really not good at it...!"
